why: The Stats tab opens without asking anyone for its numbers. This is one of the two call sites the hook has -- the Achievements tab's is the sibling entry -- and they are pinned separately because either can rot alone: Records is one menu entry with two panes, and a hook wired to only one of them leaves that tab showing whatever was last pushed for the other. Invisible to every fake-HUD test, which never runs a transition; only the real HUD can see it.
killedBy: hud: the stats page fires onRecordsOpen on an open of either tab, never on a close, and in time for the render
